lci.name: Phase X Contract Integrity
lci.assertion: For every Phase X agent operation, canonical types, governance gates, consent checks, rate limits, and audit obligations compose into one closed contract family with no authority expansion outside Limen Core.
lci.tau: tau_PhaseX = CanonicalTypes ∩ CorePermissionMapping ∩ GovernanceGate ∩ ConsentGate ∩ AuditPath ∩ EventBus ∩ RateLimit ∩ LifecycleState
tauDerivation: CanonicalTypes: all shared cross-contract types, including adapter-facing memory request DTOs, are defined only in SHARED_TYPES.md.
CorePermissionMapping: Phase X permissions are limited to Limen Core Permission strings.
GovernanceGate: every mutating operation takes OperationContext or GovernanceContext before mutation.
ConsentGate: personal data storage, transfer, and export require active consent before persistence/export.
AuditPath: allowed/sandboxed actions have before+after entries; refused/escalated actions have one terminal entry.
EventBus: Phase X emits only AgentEvent values from SHARED_TYPES.md.
RateLimit: DEFAULT_RATE_LIMITS are inherited and may only be tightened.
LifecycleState: terminal and trust state transitions are explicit and audited.

closureProof.typeClosure: All cross-contract type names are resolved through SHARED_TYPES.md; contract-local types are not referenced by other contracts.
closureProof.authorityClosure: AgentSession maps to OperationContext without adding permissions outside derivePermissions.
closureProof.eventClosure: Core hook events are translated before entering AgentEventBus.
closureProof.auditClosure: No successful side effect is returned before the required durable audit path exists.
closureProof.evolutionClosure: HB-38 requires any interface change to update the owning contract and this manifest hash.
